title: More Ceremonies (Totemic)
description: This mod adds a few new ceremonies for the Totemic Mod for mob summons and Totemic Infusion
body:
More Ceremonies
Overview

More Ceremonies currently adds a few new ceremonies for Totemic. This mod adds its ceremonies to its own page inside the totempedia under the Summoning Ceremonies Category. Currently have Song of the Cows, used to summon cows. Ballard of the Skies which is used to summon Chickens, Parrots and a Phantom and Infustion of the Totem. Will be used in the Submerged 2 modpack in the future

Infusion of the Totem

This ceremony allows you to infuse blocks around the Totem into new ones. The mod my default allows for mud to be converted into clay. This is config driven allowing it to be watever you want it to be
